summary: Comprehensive testing of BillsEasyPay Iteration 4 features: Notification system, Admin CSV/PDF exports, and Mobile responsiveness. All 18 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI tests verified notification bell, export buttons, and mobile responsive layouts on both customer and admin dashboards.
critical_code_review_comments: Notification system working correctly - GET/PUT/DELETE endpoints all functional
Notification scheduler runs every 120 seconds generating overdue, upcoming, and low_balance notifications
Email notifications are SIMULATED (logged to console/DB) - configure email service for real delivery
Admin CSV exports return proper text/csv content-type with attachment headers
Admin PDF exports return valid PDF files (verified magic bytes %PDF)
Export endpoints correctly require admin access (403 for regular users)
Mobile responsive: sidebar hidden by default, hamburger menu opens sidebar
Mobile responsive: stat cards display in 2-column grid on mobile
Mobile responsive: admin KPI cards display in 2-column grid on mobile
Mobile responsive: tables have horizontal scroll on mobile
seed_data_creation: Test user has 16 bills, $1337.00 outstanding, $460.00 paid, $1849.08 wallet balance. Admin user has 0 bills. Notifications generated by scheduler.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 testing complete. All notification CRUD endpoints tested (GET, PUT read, PUT read-all, DELETE). All admin export endpoints tested (outstanding-csv, customers-csv, outstanding-pdf, financial-pdf). Mobile responsiveness verified on customer dashboard, admin dashboard, and all admin pages. Background notification scheduler runs every 120 seconds. Email notifications are simulated (logged to console). Previous iterations: 1 (29/29), 2 (45/45), 3 (66/66), 4 (18/18 new tests).
